license_policy: Dataset images and annotations must be CC-BY-4.0; software or article license alone is insufficient.

datasets.split_plan: Reuse the existing 3496/752/752 image IDs only after manifest verification; do not redraw an easier split.
datasets.limitation: Previous test results were already inspected. This is a development benchmark, not a newly sealed independent test. Patient/slide grouping is not established.

datasets.license_evidence_note: Authors explicitly license images and annotations CC BY 4.0; repository software license is separately Apache 2.0.
datasets.split_plan: Author fold 1: train/validation/test 60/20/20. Verify filenames, hashes and burst overlap before use; preserve the official split as reference if a grouped audit requires a separate profile.
datasets.limitation: Negative class imbalance; collection sites are associated with species, so arbitrary leave-one-site-out can remove entire classes. Capture timestamps and instrument IDs are not patient IDs or guaranteed independent scenes.

datasets.split_plan: Fixed class-stratified 70/15/15, split seed 20260917; group by patient/slide when verified IDs are available. Freeze exact IDs before optical tuning.
datasets.limitation: Use original JPGs, not the MedMNIST resizing. This is the source cohort used by BloodMNIST and must not be represented as an independent new cohort. Patient-disjointness is pending metadata verification.
